extracted.intended_audience: potential subscribers and readers interested in political news and analysis (Substack readers)
extracted.subtask_description: A Substack landing / promotional page for The Bulwark newsletter that presents its contributors, mission, testimonials, subscriber count, and subscription value to recruit paid members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pro-democracy orientation and mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Described as 'the largest pro-democracy bundle on Substack for news and analysis on politics and culture.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Framing emphasizes a commitment to democracy and positions the publication explicitly within a pro-democracy posture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community built on good-faith
rubrics_metrics.description: The site is 'supported by a community built on good-faith.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims community norms of civil, good-faith engagement as part of the product proposition (implied quality of discourse and reader interactions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notable contributors / authors
rubrics_metrics.description: The Bulwark 'is home to Sarah Longwell, Tim Miller, Bill Kristol, JVL, Sam Stein, Catherine Rampell and more.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Names prominent writers as a signal of expertise and authority; contributor roster is presented as a quality metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content quality: 'smart, original and important analyses'
rubrics_metrics.description: Testimonials state: 'The Bulwark publishes smart, original and important analyses by some of our best writers across a broad spectrum a political and social concerns.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes originality, intelligence, and importance of analysis as the primary editorial quality criteria; appeals to 'thoughtful readers.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial tone: mix of rage, wisdom, humour, community
rubrics_metrics.description: Testimonial: 'Bulwark+ combines rage, wisdom, humour and community.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the emotional/tonal blend readers can expect; used as an evaluative descriptor of voice and brand.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reach / social proof: subscriber count
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Large subscriber count presented as an indicator of reach, credibility, and value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription value proposition / price signaling
rubrics_metrics.description: Testimonial: 'For $100 (toy money, anyway) a year, you get A LOT.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uses price and testimonial framing to claim high value for paid membership (Bulwark+), positioning cost as reasonable relative to offered content/community.
